what: SHA-256 digests of the files of the MaleCNS network (data/pack/malecns_v1.0/, not redistributed) that every simulation loaded, and the record of a rebuild. A network rebuilt with build_pack.py and build_mb_edges.py can be checked against these digests.

rebuild_check.what: build_pack.py and build_mb_edges.py were run, in a separate folder, from the three source files whose digests are in manifest.json. All seven files came out byte-identical to the network in use; the printed manifest equalled manifest.json; and model.Connectome built on the rebuilt files had the same dopaminergic compartment map and the same arrays as on the network in use.
rebuild_check.history_of_mb_edges_raw: mb_edges_raw.parquet of the network in use was written on 2026-10-02 by a step that was not saved as a script. build_mb_edges.py was written on 2026-10-10 to reproduce it from the source tables; this check shows that it does so byte for byte.
rebuild_check.note: The .npy files depend only on the source tables. The two parquet files are byte-identical with the same pandas and pyarrow versions (requirements-simulation.txt); with other versions compare them by value.

hub_rank_check.what: results/validation/hub_vulnerability_u.npz was first written by a step that was not saved as a script. export_hub_rank.py was written afterwards; it was run on the network in use and its output compared with the stored file.
hub_rank_check.note: Both arrays (u, ids) are identical, element for element, and the two .npy members of the archive are byte-identical. The .npz archives themselves differ in their zip headers, which depend on the numpy version.

rerun_checks.what: Reruns made with the code of this repository, in its folder layout, in a separate folder on the machine and in the environment that ran the simulations (requirements-simulation.txt). The stored result files were only read.

flywire_630_network.result: the four files of data/pack/flywire_630 came out byte-identical to the network used for the engine validation (digests in manifest_flywire.json)

engine_validation_150hz.script: validate_engine_final.py, with the stored Brian2 reference run in place
engine_validation_150hz.result: every value of results/validation/engine_validation.json reproduced (run times aside) and the four per-neuron rate vectors of engine_validation_rates.npz identical

engine_validation_200hz_100hz.script: validate_engine_200hz.py, with the stored Brian2 reference runs in place
engine_validation_200hz_100hz.result: every value of results/validation/engine_validation_200hz.json reproduced (run times aside) and the 20 arrays of engine_validation_200hz_rates.npz identical

kenyon_cell_only_design.command: assay_battery.py --design scope --scale 4 --out scope_x4.csv, on the rebuilt MaleCNS network

fly_rebuilt_from_seed.what: the example of README.md: fly 1256 of the severity series (s = 0.5) on the rebuilt network
fly_rebuilt_from_seed.result: equals the dead_frac of that fly in results/battery/stage_curve_x4.csv

brian2_reference_run_150hz.what: a new realisation, to check that the script runs and that it does not overwrite; the realisation the manuscript reports is the stored results/validation/brian2_rerun/sugarR.parquet
